prompt: On a reviewer-owned disposable isolated OVS/OVN topology or faithful harness with synthetic traffic, diagnose, contain, recover and remove an unfamiliar packet-path incident. The reviewer secretly injects one intent/compilation defect, one binding/local-realization defect, one policy/connection-state defect, one overlay/underlay or gateway defect and one outcome/observability/cleanup defect. Work without model-answer material.
deliverables: Named journey, endpoints, tenant/network, five-tuple, directions, SLO and refusal conditions
Exact OVS/OVN/CMS releases, schemas, OpenFlow protocol, datapath and topology
CMS revision to NB policy/topology and NB/northd/SB progress timeline
Chassis, encapsulation, Port_Binding and controller generation evidence
Local bridges, interfaces, ofports, links, mappings and MTU evidence
Datapath cache, upcall/revalidation, conntrack and offload evidence
ACL membership, direction, zone/state, routing, NAT and gateway evidence
Tunnel key/endpoints, effective MTU, route and bidirectional underlay proof
Transmit, receive, decapsulation, destination delivery, reply and application result
Bounded containment, supported recovery, canary and rollback
Exact cleanup and blameless prevention review
evidenceRequirements: Use only reviewer-owned disposable local infrastructure or a faithful harness with synthetic traffic
Use no production host, management interface, public target, external cloud, real credential or customer traffic
Reviewer owns hidden defects, stop authority, scoring and cleanup confirmation
Bind the user operation and resource/release/schema identities before diagnosis
Keep desired, compiled, bound, installed, cached, transmitted, received, delivered and replied states separate
Accompany quorum with transaction and generation progress
Label ovn-trace and ofproto/trace as predictions rather than delivery proof
Include protocol, bridge, table, priority, cookie, match, actions and time for flows
Bind policy direction, membership revision and exact conntrack zone/state
Bind tunnel key/endpoints, route, MTU, gateways and both directions
Give every mutation an owner, blast radius, stop condition, rollback and before/after evidence
Prove old/new application flows and exact residue absence

rubric.observableEvidence: Binds journey resources releases schemas protocol datapath and time
Proves CMS NB northd SB progress and generations
Correlates chassis ports controllers OVSDB and interfaces
Explains logical/OpenFlow pipeline caches upcalls and counters
Binds ACL membership conntrack NAT and safe handling
Proves tunnels MTU routes VLANs placement delivery and reply
Maintains authorization isolation evidence protection and stop gates
Uses supported correction canary rollback and reconciliation
Proves application SLI and exact residue absence
Produces causal timeline bounded claims owned actions and retest
